name: Over-ear headphones
summary: Two padded cups on a sprung band that slides longer or shorter on each side to fit, and folds flat.

parts.name: Headband
parts.role: The springy padded band over the head.

parts.name: Size slider
parts.role: A steel strip on each side that pulls out of the band and stays where it is left.

parts.name: Ear cup
parts.role: The padded cup with the speaker inside.
